title: Concept: Dependency declared with the GitLab shorthand
description: package.json declares the `gitlab:` dependency shorthand, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The shorthand resolves from a forge the registry never vetted and follows a moving reference, so the packaged bytes are not the reviewed bytes.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The shorthand resolves from a forge the registry never vetted and follows a moving reference, so the packaged bytes are not the reviewed bytes.
